latest_attempt.summary: final_safety_check is reconfirmed with fresh read-only evidence in the same body life (body_session 79a63de2dcfe483ea52f9ec9428c4607, death_count 0, no recovery active). Two minecraft_observe reads (journal_sequence 3 and 8) show the body alive at feet (27.5, 104.0, 0.85) in cell (27,104,0), dimension overworld/meadow, health 20.0/20.0 (> 11), food 20 (> 7), oxygen 20/20, on_ground true, in_water false, not raining, no hostile entities (only two non-hostile item entities ~5 blocks away). minecraft_inspect_block at (27,103,1) returned block_name birch_planks, is_solid true with full-cube collision and exposed 'up' face (sequence 5), proving the approach support block the body stands beside/within the 2.0 radius (~1.1 blocks). Explicit air inspections of (27,104,1) and (27,105,1) both echoed the requested position with block_name air and is_solid false (ok=false, reason not_found: 'No block exists at 27, 104, 1' / '27, 105, 1', sequences 6 and 7), giving two dry clear body cells above the support. No travel, mining, placement, or container/furnace action was performed, so the reserved footprint x=28..32 z=-1..3, the open birch_door (28,104,1), and the workstations furnace (30,102,5) / crafting_table (30,102,6) remain untouched; inventory is byte-identical to the recorded baseline (dirt 17, cobblestone 3, dandelion 3, iron_ingot 3, birch_door 2, egg 2, iron_pickaxe 1, stone_pickaxe 1), so the retained uncertain actor-0027 withdraw shows no missing supply and needed no replacement. Durable journal note f3f0649e5c5842738572717c30947dd4 was saved, plus scratch/task-card.md and outbox/handoff.md. actor_instructions revision 0 confirmed no instruction change.
